items.title:
org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-liquibase 14.73.0 发布, Source of truth for the Dirigible system schema (DIRIGIBLE_*) running in SystemDB.
        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.

items.title:
io.github.shrinivas93:rest-in-peace-spring-boot-starter 1.0.0.53 发布, Spring Boot auto-configuration for REST-in-peace: auto-registers every
		@RestClient interface found on the classpath as a Spring bean, instead
		of one hand-written @Bean method per interface. See
		docs/design/spring-boot-starter.md in the parent repository for the
		full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/ (not
		a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the same
		way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Requires Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4.x; the core
		rest-in-peace library itself stays on Java 8.

items.title:
fr.mieuxvoter:kmj-android 0.4.1 发布, A Kotlin Multiplatform library to efficiently rank candidates using Majority Judgment.
Majority Judgment is an elegant voting system used in french wine contests, among other things.
Its resolution does not require a computer, but it's still handy to be able to do it digitally.

This library supports arbitrarily large amounts of voters — and millions of candidates.
In addition to ranking, it also provides an extensive analysis of the merit profiles,
including a scalar majority merit value that can be useful in a number of ways.

For impeccable accuracy and reliability, this library does not use floating-point numbers.
It also provides three utilities to balance your tallies, including a Least-Common-Multiple-based normalization.
